result:
If I could change the world in one way, I would make it impossible for anyone to feel that their own suffering is a private, shameful thing.

I’d want every person to meet their own fragility with the same gentleness they’d offer a friend — and to know, without having to prove it, that they are not alone in it. The world would still have its hard edges, its losses, its unfairness. But no one would have to carry those things in secret, and no one would feel that asking for help made them smaller.

That kind of change wouldn’t fix everything overnight, but it would change how people hold each other — and maybe that’s the root of the rest.
